source_status: MIT independent paper implementation; not original-author code; research engine distinct from experimental Freqtrade adapter
primary_files: DONCHIAN_PRIMARY_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT.json (seven exact Git blobs with UTF8 SHA256)
native_market_universe: daily crypto spot/cash price-panel standalone BTC; full monthly Top-B cross-sectional portfolio is a separate case; BingX perpetual not native

rules.channels: U_n(t)=max(C[t-n+1:t]); L_n(t)=min(C[t-n+1:t]); M_n(t)=(U_n(t)+L_n(t))/2; current C_t included
rules.initial_state: inactive, stop=NaN per horizon; no missing/nonfinite channel update; inherited source state must be explicitly carried for OOS, not reset at measurement start
rules.entry: inactive and C_t>=U_n(t): active=1, next fixed stop=M_n(t)
rules.exit: active and C_t<=stop fixed no later than t-1: active=0, no same-row reentry; stop=NaN for subsequent row
rules.survival: active and C_t>old stop: remain active; tomorrow stop=max(old stop,M_n(t)); stop never decreases
rules.combo: k_t=sum(active horizon); f_t=k_t/9; aggregate k change forces resizing, offset horizon swaps do not
rules.risk: r_t=C_t/C_(t-1)-1 only consecutive calendar-day pairs; sigma_t=sample_std(last90 consecutive r)*sqrt(365); scalar=clip(0.25/sigma_t,0,2); desired=scalar*f_t; missing/zero volatility ideal=0
rules.band: current drifted weight=current notional/current fee-aware equity after day-t return; count change executes immediately; otherwise execute desired only abs(desired-current)/abs(current)>0.20; current=0,desired>0 is immediate entry; exact20% does not rebalance
rules.accounting: PnL_t=position_(t-1)*asset_return_t; after marking t, resize at academic same close C_t; solve trade size + fee simultaneously on postfee equity
rules.cost: 0.001*abs(delta traded notional) EACH ONE-WAY leg; approx20bps full buy/sell RT before other BingX costs; do not relabel10bps as RT
rules.holding_exit: state until previous-fixed-stop close exit; no fixed timeout, no intraday SL or TP; initial measurement holdings need state_start/anchor contract
rules.signal_time: completed daily C_t; ZEL modeled availability t+1 00:00 UTC only conditional on historical time=open-label interpretation; receipt retrieval not historic delivery
rules.earliest_causal_entry: first executable quote after completed close and signal calculation; original academic same-close accounting does not certify an executable post-decision BingX fill
rules.not_transferred: monthly Top-B eligibility/volume/rank/rotation rules, funding, borrowing, liquidation and venue costs; static six-universe is an explicit translation, not source-native portfolio
